User question: Identify the individuals who have served on the board of companies that are subsidiaries of Czech Media Invest, and specify how many such companies each individual has been associated with.

Query Generator's natural language explanation of its own query:
The query finds all companies that are direct subsidiaries of 'Czech Media Invest' via the subsidiaryOf relationship, then identifies persons who are board members (hasBoardMember) of those subsidiaries. MATCH (parent:Company {name: 'Czech Media Invest'})<-[:subsidiaryOf]-(sub:Company)-[:hasBoardMember]->(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS individual, COUNT(DISTINCT sub) AS number_of_companies

Query Generator's natural language explanation of its own query:
The query first finds all persons who are connected to the GitHub Inc. company via a hasCEO relationship. MATCH (gh:Company {name:'GitHub Inc.'})-[:hasCEO]->(p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Company)-[:hasCEO]->(p) RETURN p.name AS CEO_Name, COUNT(DISTINCT c) AS Number_Of_Companies_As_CEO
